hero.glas_aria: The homepage of amakhosi.be on a computer, as a visitor sees it. The image slowly scrolls from top to bottom.
caps: The headline says it straight away: Koninklijk genieten, helemaal privé. One button: Reserveer uw moment.
The ribbon of amenities runs along. Below it, the welcome in warm African surroundings.
Serif headings, espresso and gold. The style of the business runs through every section.
The photo grid: whirlpool, Finnish sauna, walk-in shower, lounge and fireplace, bedroom suite.

cases.kort: New website for a private sauna and wellness in Hamont-Achel, with online booking and payment, automatic emails and a site Google reads well.
cases.gemaakt: Website · Online booking and payment · Automatic emails · Easy to find on Google
beats: A luxury private sauna and wellness in Hamont-Achel. Guests have the whole wellness to themselves.

A new website in espresso and gold, with serif headings, an opening image with the whirlpool in an arch, a running ribbon of amenities and a photo grid of the rooms. Online booking with immediate payment. Automatic emails with confirmation, reminder and follow-up. And built so Google reads the site well.
A guest picks a moment, pays straight away and gets confirmation, reminder and follow-up in their inbox automatically.

dienst.label: More about websites with online booking

cases.kort: Website, online calendar and automatic emails for a medical aesthetic clinic in Hasselt. Over 263 days: 650 of 681 appointments confirmed.
cases.alt: Homepage of clinic3d.be: a light, warm site in beige and gold with the headline Natuurlijke schoonheid, wetenschappelijk onderbouwd, a portrait of Dr. Sasha Kenis and the buttons Boek je afspraak and Onze behandelingen, with photos of the clinic below.
cases.soort: Medical aesthetic clinic · Hasselt · Dr. Kenis
beats: Medical aesthetic clinic in Hasselt. Dr. Kenis carries out every treatment himself.

The website, in warm beige and gold, with Dr. Kenis in the picture, real photos of the clinic and all treatments laid out clearly. Plus the online calendar and the automatic emails: patients pick a moment themselves, confirmation and reminder go out automatically.
Measured over 263 days: 650 of the 681 appointments confirmed.
cases.meet_noot: Measured over 263 days. The figures come from our platform's reporting.

quote.text: 227 appointments in 104 days, […] and my calendar is fuller than ever. My clients book themselves now. I don't have to do a thing.

cases.kort: New website for a non-profit in Heers, connected to automated follow-up and a central CRM.
cases.alt: Homepage of mett-u.be: a green header VZW Mett-U with two buttons and a photo of volunteers in the vegetable garden.
beats: A new website, connected to automated follow-up and a central CRM.
The site does not stand alone: the follow-up and the CRM are attached to it.

cases.kort: New website for an organic and care farm in Vechmaal, with their story, their animals and crops, and a page where you reserve their produce online.
cases.alt: Homepage of kleinhof.be: a photo of a grain field with the handwritten caption de akkers in Vechmaal, below it the headline Biologisch kleinschalig and the button Producten reserveren.
cases.soort: Organic and care farm · Vechmaal · Liesbeth and Gert
beats: A small-scale organic and care farm in Vechmaal, the same village as EM Launchpad.

A new website, calm and rural like a small farm newspaper: large photos of the fields, their story, the animals and the crops, and a page where you reserve eggs, potatoes, onions and beef online. You pay on collection. Anyone who wants to stay up to date can sign up for their newsletter.
Anyone looking for them sees straight away who they are and what they grow, and reserves their produce online.

cases.kort: New website for baby wellness and care for mums in Lommel, with the booking system and add-ons, a digital gift card and automatic emails.
cases.alt: Homepage of bambine.be: a baby peeking out from under a white towel, with the headline Een warm bad voor de allerkleinsten and the buttons Reserveer jullie moment and Bekijk de cadeaubonnen.
cases.soort: Baby wellness and care for mums · Lommel · Ine
cases.gemaakt: Website · Booking system with add-ons · Digital gift card · Automatic emails
beats: Baby wellness, care for mums and pampering moments in the Vivaldi gallery in Lommel. Ine works one on one.
A new website in gold, light brown and white, with arched images and the prices laid out like a menu. Plus the booking system with add-ons, a digital gift card and automatic emails.
Parents book a moment online themselves and can add an extra, such as a gentle wash. A gift card can be bought straight away in digital form.

cases.kop_b: You can tell at a glance.
cases.kort: New website for a chip shop and cyclists' café in Borgloon, with the menu, opening hours that show whether they are open right now, a page for groups and a contact form.
cases.alt: Homepage of frituurmadelyn.be: a dark photo of fresh fries in a frying basket, with the headline Frituur Madelyn, the buttons Bekijk het menu and Bel, and the notice Nu open.
cases.soort: Chip shop and cyclists' café · Borgloon · Ravi and Sam
cases.gemaakt: Website · Menu · Groups and day trips · Contact form
beats: A chip shop and cyclists' café on the Graethempoort in Borgloon, open 7 days a week. Ravi and Sam run the place.

A new website in red and white, with real photos of the shop and the display counter. The menu by category, opening hours that tell you themselves whether they are open now, a page for cyclists, coaches and clubs, and a contact form that arrives in our platform.
Anyone searching on their phone sees straight away what is on the menu, whether they are open and how to call. Groups request their quote through the form.
